apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: eval-routed-ot3qzsy
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: eval-http
  namespace: eval-routed-ot3qzsy
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: eval-http
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: eval-http
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - operator: Exists
      containers:
      - name: http
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
        args:
        - mkdir -p /www; printf 'evaluator-http-%s\n' "$(hostname)" > /www/index.html; exec httpd -f -p 8080 -h /www
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: eval-http
  namespace: eval-routed-ot3qzsy
spec:
  selector:
    app: eval-http
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: eval-client
  namespace: eval-routed-ot3qzsy
  labels:
    app: eval-client
